mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months, signaling labor market tightness, this triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 return as investors anticipate higher inflation and potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: In tight labor market regime, 20-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing >0.3pp threshold (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand growth) and decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) creates a positive feedback loop, lowering real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises while FEDFUNDS falls over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 up and FEDFUNDS down (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals slowing price pressures, prompting market anticipation of rate cuts and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive during late-cycle expansion when CPIAUCSL declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading above 112.5 triggers a positive 5-day S&P 500 return as strong production growth signals robust economic health and investor optimism.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses threshold in expanding economy (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (demand) rises while FEDFUNDS (monetary) falls, indicating strengthening demand and easing policy, this dual trend lowers real rates and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises while FEDFUNDS falls over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when the interaction occurs (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in RSAFS (demand) and decrease in UNRATE (labor) signals improved economic momentum, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive during post-shock recovery when RSAFS up and UNRATE down (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (labor) rises by more than 5,000 over a month, signaling labor market tightness, this triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 return as investors anticipate higher wages and inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative when PAYEMS crosses threshold in tight labor market (p > 0.05).
